units.zh: 聖宗五
units.en: Shengzong, Part Five
units.literal: Shengzong, Part Five

units.zh: 十六年春正月乙丑，如長濼。
units.en: In the sixteenth year of Tonghe, on yichou day of the first spring month, the Emperor went to Chang Marsh.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year, spring, first month, on yichou day, he went to Chang Marsh.

units.zh: 二月庚子，夏國遣使來貢。
units.en: On gengzi day of the second month Western Xia sent tribute envoys.
units.literal: In the second month, on gengzi day, Xia State dispatched envoys to come with tribute.

units.zh: 丙午，以監門衛上將軍耶律喜羅為中臺省左相。
units.en: On bingwu day Gate Guard senior general Yelü Xiluo was appointed left chancellor of the Central Secretariat.
units.literal: On bingwu day, made Gate Guard senior general Yelü Xiluo Central Secretariat left chancellor.

units.zh: 三月甲子，女直遣使來貢。
units.en: On jiazi day of the third month the Jurchen sent tribute envoys.
units.literal: In the third month, on jiazi day, the Jurchen dispatched envoys to come with tribute.

units.zh: 乙亥，鼻骨德酋長來貢。
units.en: On yihai day a Biegude chieftain came with tribute.
units.literal: On yihai day, a Biegude chieftain came with tribute.

units.zh: 夏四月癸卯，振崇德宮所隸州縣民之被水者。
units.en: On guimao day of the fourth summer month the court provided relief to flood victims among the people of the prefectures and counties under Chongde Palace.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, on guimao day, relief was given to the people of prefectures and counties subordinate to Chongde Palace who had been inundated by flood.

units.zh: 丁未，罷民輸官俸，給自內帑。
units.en: On dingwei day the court ended the practice of having the people supply official salaries, and salaries were paid from the inner treasury.
units.literal: On dingwei day, ended the people supplying official salaries; payment was made from the inner treasury.

units.zh: 己酉，祈雨。
units.en: On jiyou day the court prayed for rain.
units.literal: On jiyou day, prayed for rain.

units.zh: 乙卯，如木葉山。
units.en: On yimao day the Emperor went to Mount Muye.
units.literal: On yimao day, went to Mount Muye.

units.zh: 五月甲子，祭白馬神。
units.en: On jiazi day of the fifth month the court sacrificed to the White Horse Spirit.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on jiazi day, sacrificed to the White Horse Spirit.

units.zh: 丁卯，祠木葉山，告來歲南伐。
units.en: On dingmao day the court sacrificed at Mount Muye and proclaimed the southern campaign for the coming year.
units.literal: On dingmao day, offered sacrifice at Mount Muye, announcing next year's southern campaign.

units.zh: 庚辰，鐵驪來貢。
units.en: On gengchen day the Iron Li came with tribute.
units.literal: On gengchen day, the Iron Li came with tribute.

units.zh: 乙酉，還上京。
units.en: On yiyou day the court returned to the Supreme Capital.
units.literal: On yiyou day, returned to the Supreme Capital.

units.zh: 婦人年逾九十者賜物。
units.en: Women over ninety years of age were granted gifts.
units.literal: Women over ninety years of age were granted gifts.

units.zh: 六月戊子朔，致奠於祖、懷二陵。
units.en: On the wuzi new moon of the sixth month offerings were presented at the Ancestor and Huai mausoleums.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on wuzi new moon, offerings were made at the Ancestor and Huai mausoleums.

units.zh: 是月，清暑炭山。
units.en: That month the court took the summer retreat at Coal Mountain.
units.literal: That month, took summer coolness at Coal Mountain.

units.zh: 秋七月丁巳朔，錄囚，聽政。
units.en: On the dingsi new moon of the seventh autumn month the court reviewed prisoners and held audiences.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on dingsi new moon, reviewed prisoners and held court.

units.zh: 八月丁亥朔，東幸。
units.en: On the dinghai new moon of the eighth month the court traveled east.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on dinghai new moon, traveled east.

units.zh: 九月丁巳朔，駐蹕得勝口。
units.en: On the dingsi new moon of the ninth month the court encamped at Desheng Pass.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on dingsi new moon, imperial halt at Desheng Pass.

units.zh: 冬十一月，遣使冊高麗國王誦。
units.en: In the eleventh winter month envoys were dispatched to invest Goryeo King Song.
units.literal: In winter, eleventh month, dispatched envoys to invest Goryeo King Song.

units.zh: 十二月丙戌朔，宋國王休哥薨，輟朝五日。
units.en: On the bingxu new moon of the twelfth month Song King Xiuge died, and court was suspended for five days.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on bingxu new moon, Song King Xiuge died; court audiences were suspended for five days.

units.zh: 進封皇弟恒王隆慶為梁國王、南京留守，鄭王隆祐為吳國王。
units.en: The Emperor's younger brother Prince of Heng Longqing was advanced and enfeoffed as Prince of Liang and Nanjing garrison commander, and Prince of Zheng Longyou as Prince of Wu.
units.literal: Advanced and enfeoffed the Emperor's younger brother Prince of Heng Longqing as Prince of Liang and Nanjing garrison commander; Prince of Zheng Longyou as Prince of Wu.

units.zh: 是年，放進士楊又玄等二人。
units.en: That year Yang Youxuan and one other passed the examinations.
units.literal: That year, jinshi Yang Youxuan and one other were passed.

units.zh: 十七年春正月乙卯朔，如長春宮。
units.en: In the seventeenth year of Tonghe, on the yimao new moon of the first spring month, the Emperor went to Changchun Palace.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year, spring, first month, on yimao new moon, went to Changchun Palace.

units.zh: 夏四月，如炭山清暑。
units.en: In the fourth summer month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, went to Coal Mountain for summer coolness.

units.zh: 六月，兀惹烏昭慶來。
units.en: In the sixth month Wuran's Wuzhaoqing came.
units.literal: In the sixth month, Wuran's Wuzhaoqing came.

units.zh: 秋七月，以伐宋詔諭諸道。
units.en: In the seventh autumn month an edict notified all circuits of the campaign against Song.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, by edict announced the campaign against Song to all circuits.

units.zh: 九月庚辰朔，幸南京。
units.en: On the gengchen new moon of the ninth month the court went to Nanjing.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on gengchen new moon, favored Nanjing.

units.zh: 乙亥，南伐。
units.en: On yihai day a southern campaign was launched.
units.literal: On yihai day, southern campaign.

units.zh: 癸卯，射鬼箭。
units.en: On guimao day the court shot ghost arrows.
units.literal: On guimao day, shot ghost arrows.

units.zh: 北院樞密使魏王耶律斜軫薨。
units.en: Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Xiezhen died.
units.literal: Northern Court Privy Commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Xiezhen died.

units.zh: 以韓德讓兼知北院樞密使事。
units.en: Han Derang was also made administrator of Northern Court privy affairs.
units.literal: Made Han Derang also administrator of Northern Court privy affairs.

units.zh: 冬十月癸酉，攻遂城，不克，遣蕭繼遠攻狼山鎮石砦，破之。
units.en: On guiyou day of the tenth winter month the army attacked Suicheng without success; Xiao Jiyuan was sent to attack the Stone Stockade at Langshan town and took it.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, on guiyou day, attacked Suicheng but did not take it; dispatched Xiao Jiyuan to attack Langshan town's Stone Stockade and broke it.

units.zh: 次瀛州，與宋軍戰，擒其將康昭裔、宋順，獲兵仗、器甲無算。
units.en: At Ying Prefecture the army fought Song forces, captured generals Kang Zhaoyi and Song Shun, and seized countless weapons and armor.
units.literal: Halting at Ying Prefecture, fought Song troops, captured their generals Kang Zhaoyi and Song Shun, obtained weapons and armor beyond counting.

units.zh: 進攻樂壽縣，拔之。
units.en: The army advanced against Leshou County and took it.
units.literal: Advanced to attack Leshou County and stormed it.

units.zh: 次遂城，敵眾臨水以拒，縱騎兵突之，殺戮殆盡。
units.en: At Suicheng the enemy massed along the water to resist; cavalry was sent in a charge and nearly all were slaughtered.
units.literal: Halting at Suicheng, the enemy masses faced the water to resist; cavalry was loosed to charge them, and nearly all were slaughtered.

units.zh: 是年，放進士初錫等四人及第。
units.en: That year Chu Xi and three others passed the examinations.
units.literal: That year, jinshi Chu Xi and three others were passed and granted degree.

units.zh: 十八年春正月，還次南京，賞有功將士，罰不用命者。
units.en: In the eighteenth year of Tonghe, in the first spring month the court returned to Nanjing, rewarded officers and soldiers who had distinguished themselves, and punished those who had disobeyed orders.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, returned and halted at Nanjing, rewarded meritorious officers and soldiers, punished those who disobeyed orders.

units.zh: 詔諸軍各還本道，二月，幸延芳澱。
units.en: An edict ordered all armies to return to their home circuits, and in the second month the court went to Yanfang Marsh.
units.literal: An edict ordered the various armies each to return to their original circuits; in the second month, favored and visited Yanfang Marsh.

units.zh: 夏四月己未，駐蹕於清泉澱。
units.en: On jiwei day of the fourth summer month the court encamped at Qingquan Marsh.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, on jiwei day, imperial halt at Qingquan Marsh.

units.zh: 五月丁酉，清暑炭山。
units.en: On dingyou day of the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Coal Mountain.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on dingyou day, summer coolness at Coal Mountain.

units.zh: 六月，阻卜叛酋鶻碾之弟鐵剌不率部眾來附，鶻碾無所歸，遂降，詔誅之。
units.en: In the sixth month Zubu rebel chieftain Guinian's brother Tielabu submitted with his followers; with nowhere to go Guinian surrendered, and an edict ordered his execution.
units.literal: In the sixth month, Zubu rebel chieftain Guinian's younger brother Tielabu led his tribes to come and attach; Guinian had nowhere to go, then surrendered; an edict ordered his execution.

units.zh: 秋七月，駐蹕於湯泉。
units.en: In the seventh autumn month the court encamped at Tangquan.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, imperial halt at Tangquan.

units.zh: 九月乙亥朔，駐蹕黑河。
units.en: On the yihai new moon of the ninth month the court encamped at Heihe.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on yihai new moon, imperial halt at Heihe.

units.zh: 冬十一月甲戌朔，授西平王李繼遷子德昭朔方軍節度使。
units.en: On the jiaxu new moon of the eleventh winter month Li Jiqian's son Dezhao was appointed military commissioner of the Shuofang Army.
units.literal: In winter, eleventh month, on jiaxu new moon, granted Western Peace King Li Jiqian's son Dezhao as Shuofang Army military commissioner.

units.zh: 十二月，回鶻來貢。
units.en: In the twelfth month the Uyghur came with tribute.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, the Uyghur came with tribute.

units.zh: 是年，放進士南承保等三人及第。
units.en: That year Nan Chengbao and two others passed the examinations.
units.literal: That year, jinshi Nan Chengbao and two others were passed and granted degree.

units.zh: 十九年春正月辛巳，以祗候郎君班詳穩觀音為奚六部大王。
units.en: In the nineteenth year of Tonghe, on xinsi day of the first spring month, zhihou langjun xiangwen Guanyin was appointed king of the Six Xi Divisions.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on xinsi day, appointed zhihou langjun class xiangwen Guanyin as King of the Six Xi Divisions.

units.zh: 甲申，回鶻進梵僧名醫。
units.en: On jiashen day the Uyghur presented Buddhist monks and renowned physicians.
units.literal: On jiashen day the Uyghur presented Buddhist monks and famous physicians.

units.zh: 三月乙亥，夏國遣李文貴來貢。
units.en: On yihai day of the third month Western Xia sent Li Wengui with tribute.
units.literal: In the third month, on yihai day, Xia State dispatched Li Wengui to come with tribute.

units.zh: 乙酉，西南面招討司奏党項捷。
units.en: On yiyou day the Southwestern Pacification Commission reported a victory over the Tangut.
units.literal: On yiyou day the Southwestern Pacification Commission reported Tangut victory.

units.zh: 壬辰，皇后蕭氏以罪降為貴妃。
units.en: On renchen day Empress Xiao was demoted to noble consort on account of misconduct.
units.literal: On renchen day Empress Xiao was demoted to noble consort because of crime.

units.zh: 賜大丞相韓德讓名德昌。
units.en: Grand Chancellor Han Derang was granted the name Dechang.
units.literal: Granted Grand Chancellor Han Derang the name Dechang.

units.zh: 夏四月乙巳，幸吳國王隆祐第視疾。
units.en: On yisi day of the fourth summer month the Emperor visited Prince of Wu Longyou's residence to inquire after his illness.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, on yisi day, favored and visited Prince of Wu Longyou's residence to see illness.

units.zh: 丙午，問安皇太后。
units.en: On bingwu day the Emperor inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.
units.literal: On bingwu day inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.

units.zh: 五月癸酉，清暑炭山。
units.en: On guiyou day of the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Coal Mountain.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on guiyou day, summer coolness at Coal Mountain.

units.zh: 丙戌，冊蕭氏為齊天皇后。
units.en: On bingxu day Xiao was invested as Empress Qitian.
units.literal: On bingxu day enfeoffed Xiao as Qitian Empress.

units.zh: 庚寅，以千拽剌詳穩耶律王奴為乙室大王。
units.en: On gengyin day qianzhuaila xiangwen Yelü Wangnu was appointed Prince of Yishi.
units.literal: On gengyin day appointed qianzhuaila xiangwen Yelü Wangnu as Prince of Yishi.

units.zh: 辛卯，以青牛白馬祭天地。
units.en: On xinmao day the court sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.
units.literal: On xinmao day used green ox and white horse to sacrifice to heaven and earth.

units.zh: 六月乙巳，以所俘宋將康昭裔為昭順軍節度使。
units.en: On yisi day of the sixth month captured Song general Kang Zhaoyi was appointed military commissioner of the Zhaoshun Army.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on yisi day, made captured Song general Kang Zhaoyi Zhao Shun Army military commissioner.

units.zh: 戊午，夏國奏下宋恒、環、慶等三州，賜詔褒之。
units.en: On wuwu day Western Xia reported the capture of Song's Heng, Huan, Qing, and other prefectures, and an edict was issued to commend them.
units.literal: On wuwu day Xia State memorialized capturing Song Heng, Huan, Qing and three other prefectures; granted edict to praise them.

units.zh: 秋七月丙戌，以東京統軍使耶律奴瓜為南府宰相。
units.en: On bingxu day in the seventh autumn month Eastern Capital army commander Yelü Nugua was appointed Southern Chancellery chancellor.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on bingxu day, made Eastern Capital army commander Yelü Nugua Southern Chancellery Chancellor.

units.zh: 八月庚戌，達盧骨部來貢。
units.en: On gengxu day of the eighth month the Dalugu tribe came with tribute.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on gengxu day, the Dalugu tribe came with tribute.

units.zh: 九月己巳朔，問安皇太后。
units.en: On the jisi new moon of the ninth month the Emperor inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on jisi new moon, inquired after Empress Dowager's health.

units.zh: 戊子，駐蹕昌平。
units.en: On wuzi day the court encamped at Changping.
units.literal: On wuzi day imperial halt at Changping.

units.zh: 庚寅，西南面招討司奏討吐谷渾捷。
units.en: On gengyin day the Southwestern Pacification Commission reported a victory over the Tuyuhun.
units.literal: On gengyin day Southwestern Pacification Commission reported victory attacking Tuyuhun.

units.zh: 辛卯，幸南京。
units.en: On xinmao day the court visited Nanjing.
units.literal: On xinmao day favorably visited Nanjing.

units.zh: 冬十月己亥，南伐。
units.en: On jihai day of the tenth winter month a southern campaign was launched.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, on jihai day, southern campaign.

units.zh: 壬寅，次鹽溝。
units.en: On renyin day the army halted at Yan Gou.
units.literal: On renyin day halted at Yan Gou.

units.zh: 徙封吳國王隆祐為楚國王，留守京師。
units.en: Prince of Wu Longyou was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Chu and left to guard the capital.
units.literal: Transferred enfeoffment of Prince of Wu Longyou to Prince of Chu, remaining to guard the capital.

units.zh: 丁未，梁國王隆慶統先鋒軍以進。
units.en: On dingwei day Prince of Liang Longqing led the vanguard army forward.
units.literal: On dingwei day Prince of Liang Longqing commanded vanguard army to advance.

units.zh: 辛亥，射鬼箭。
units.en: On xinhai day ghost arrows were shot.
units.literal: On xinhai day shot ghost arrows.

units.zh: 壬子，以青牛白馬祭天地。
units.en: On renzi day the court sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.
units.literal: On renzi day used green ox and white horse to sacrifice to heaven and earth.

units.zh: 甲寅，遼軍與宋兵戰於遂城，敗之。
units.en: On jiayin day Liao forces defeated Song troops at Suicheng.
units.literal: On jiayin day Liao army battled Song troops at Suicheng, defeated them.

units.zh: 庚申，以黑白羊祭天地。
units.en: On gengshen day the court sacrificed black and white sheep to heaven and earth.
units.literal: On gengshen day used black and white sheep to sacrifice to heaven and earth.

units.zh: 丙寅，次滿城，以泥淖班師。
units.en: On bingyin day the army halted at Mancheng and, bogged down in mud, withdrew.
units.literal: On bingyin day halted at Mancheng, because of mud and mire withdrew army.

units.zh: 十一月庚午，射鬼箭。
units.en: On gengwu day of the eleventh month ghost arrows were shot.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengwu day, shot ghost arrows.

units.zh: 丙子，宋兵出淤口、益津關來侵，偵候謀窪、虞人招古擊敗之。
units.en: On bingzi day Song troops attacked through Yukou and Yijin Pass; scouts Mouwa and gamekeeper Zhao Gu drove them back.
units.literal: On bingzi day Song troops came out of Yukou and Yijin Pass to invade; scout Mouwa and huntsman Zhao Gu defeated them.

units.zh: 己卯，觀漁儒門濼。
units.en: On jimao day the court watched fishing at Rumen Marsh.
units.literal: On jimao day viewed fishing at Rumen Marsh.

units.zh: 閏月己酉，鼻骨德來貢。
units.en: On jiyou day of the intercalary month the Bigud came with tribute.
units.literal: In the intercalary month, on jiyou day, the Bigud came with tribute.

units.zh: 己未，減關市稅。
units.en: On jiwei day frontier market taxes were reduced.
units.literal: On jiwei day reduced frontier market taxes.

units.zh: 十二月庚辰，免南京、平州租稅。
units.en: On gengchen day of the twelfth month rent and taxes at Nanjing and Ping Prefecture were remitted.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengchen day, exempted Nanjing and Ping Prefecture rent and taxes.

units.zh: 二十年春正月庚子，如延芳澱。
units.en: In the twentieth year of Tonghe, on gengzi day of the first spring month the Emperor went to Yanfang Marsh.
units.literal: In the twentieth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on gengzi day, went to Yanfang Marsh.

units.zh: 癸丑，東方五色虹見。
units.en: On guichou day a five-colored rainbow appeared in the east.
units.literal: On guichou day five-colored rainbow appeared in the east.

units.zh: 詔安撫西南面向化諸部。
units.en: An edict ordered the pacification of the submitted tribes of the southwest.
units.literal: An edict ordered pacifying the various southwestern submitted tribes.

units.zh: 甲寅，夏國遣使貢馬、駝。
units.en: On jiayin day Western Xia sent envoys presenting horses and camels.
units.literal: On jiayin day Xia State dispatched envoys to present horses and camels.

units.zh: 辛酉，女直宰相夷離底來貢。
units.en: On xinyou day Jurchen chancellor Yilidi came with tribute.
units.literal: On xinyou day Jurchen chancellor Yilidi came with tribute.

units.zh: 二月丁丑，女直遣其子來朝。
units.en: In the second month, on dingchou day, a Jurchen chieftain sent his son to court.
units.literal: In the second month, on dingchou day, the Jurchen dispatched their son to come to court.

units.zh: 高麗遣使賀伐宋捷。
units.en: Goryeo sent envoys congratulating the court on victory over Song.
units.literal: Goryeo dispatched envoys to congratulate on the victory attacking Song.

units.zh: 三月甲寅，遣北府宰相蕭繼遠等南伐。
units.en: On jiayin day of the third month Northern Chancellery chancellor Xiao Jiyuan and others were sent on a southern campaign.
units.literal: In the third month, on jiayin day, dispatched Northern Chancellery Chancellor Xiao Jiyuan and others on southern campaign.

units.zh: 壬戌，駐蹕鴛鴦濼。
units.en: On renxu day the court encamped at Yuanyang Marsh.
units.literal: On renxu day imperial halt at Yuanyang Marsh.

units.zh: 夏四月丙寅朔，文班太保達裏底敗宋兵於梁門。
units.en: On the bingyin new moon of the fourth summer month Civil Class grand guardian Dalidi defeated Song troops at Liangmen.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, on bingyin new moon, Civil Class Grand Guardian Dalidi defeated Song troops at Liangmen.

units.zh: 甲戌，南京統軍使蕭撻凜破宋軍於泰州。
units.en: On jiaxu day Nanjing army commander Xiao Talin routed Song forces at Taizhou.
units.literal: On jiaxu day Nanjing army commander Xiao Talin broke Song army at Taizhou.

units.zh: 乙酉，南征將校獻俘。
units.en: On yiyou day the officers of the southern campaign presented captives.
units.literal: On yiyou day southern campaign officers presented captives.

units.zh: 賜爵賞有差。
units.en: Titles and rewards were granted according to rank.
units.literal: Granted ranks and rewards in differing amounts.

units.zh: 戊子，鐵驪遣使來貢。
units.en: On wuzi day the Iron Li sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: On wuzi day the Iron Li dispatched envoys to come with tribute.

units.zh: 五月乙卯，幸炭山清暑。
units.en: On yimao day of the fifth month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on yimao day, favored Coal Mountain for summer coolness.

units.zh: 六月，夏國遣劉仁勖來告下靈州。
units.en: In the sixth month Western Xia sent Liu Renxu to report the capture of Ling Prefecture.
units.literal: In the sixth month, Xia State dispatched Liu Renxu to report capturing Ling Prefecture.

units.zh: 秋七月甲午朔，日有食之。
units.en: On the jiawu new moon of the seventh autumn month there was a solar eclipse.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on jiawu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 丁酉，以邢抱樸為南院樞密使。
units.en: On dingyou day Xing Baopu was appointed southern privy commissioner.
units.literal: On dingyou day made Xing Baopu Southern Chancellery Privy Commissioner.

units.zh: 辛丑，高麗遣使來貢本國地理圖。
units.en: On xinchou day Goryeo sent envoys presenting a geographical map of their realm.
units.literal: On xinchou day Goryeo dispatched envoys to come with tribute of their country's geographical map.

units.zh: 九月癸巳朔，謁顯陵，告南伐捷。
units.en: On the guisi new moon of the ninth month the Emperor visited the Xian Mausoleum and reported the southern victory.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on guisi new moon, visited Xian Mausoleum, reported southern campaign victory.

units.zh: 冬十月癸亥朔，至自顯陵。
units.en: On the guihai new moon of the tenth winter month the court returned from the Xian Mausoleum.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, on guihai new moon, returned from Xian Mausoleum.

units.zh: 十二月，奚王府五帳六節度獻七金山土河川地，賜金幣。
units.en: In the twelfth month the Xi princely establishment's five households and six divisions offered land along the Qijin Mountains and the Tuh River; gold and coins were granted in return.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, the Xi princely establishment's five households and six military commissions presented land of Qijin Mountain, Tuh River valley; granted gold and coins.

units.zh: 是歲，南京、平州麥秀兩歧。
units.en: That year wheat with double ears appeared at Nanjing and Ping Prefecture.
units.literal: That year, Nanjing and Ping Prefecture wheat showed two ears per stalk.

units.zh: 放進士邢祥等六人及第。
units.en: Xing Xiang and five others passed the examinations.
units.literal: Jinshi Xing Xiang and six others were passed and granted degree.

units.zh: 二十一年春正月，如鴛鴦濼。
units.en: In the twenty-first year of Tonghe, in the first spring month the Emperor went to Yuanyang Marsh.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year of Tonghe, spring, first month, went to Yuanyang Marsh.

units.zh: 三月壬辰，詔修日曆官毋書細事。
units.en: On renchen day of the third month an edict forbade calendar officials from recording trivial events.
units.literal: In the third month, on renchen day, an edict ordered calendar officials not to record minor matters.

units.zh: 甲午，朝皇太后。
units.en: On jiawu day the Emperor attended upon the Empress Dowager.
units.literal: On jiawu day audience with Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 戊午，鐵驪來貢。
units.en: On wuwu day the Iron Li came with tribute.
units.literal: On wuwu day the Iron Li came with tribute.

units.zh: 夏四月乙丑，女直遣使來貢。
units.en: On yichou day of the fourth summer month the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, on yichou day, the Jurchen dispatched envoys to come with tribute.

units.zh: 戊辰，兀惹、渤海、奧裏米、越裏篤、越裏吉等五部遣使來貢。
units.en: On wuchen day Wuran, Bohai, Aolimi, Yuelidu, Yueliji, and other tribes sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: On wuchen day Wuran, Bohai, Aolimi, Yuelidu, Yueliji and five other divisions dispatched envoys to come with tribute.

units.zh: 是月，耶律奴瓜、蕭撻凜獲宋將王繼忠於望都。
units.en: That month Yelü Nugua and Xiao Talin captured Song general Wang Jizhong at Wangdu.
units.literal: That month, Yelü Nugua, Xiao Talin captured Song general Wang Jizhong at Wangdu.

units.zh: 五月庚寅朔，清暑炭山。
units.en: On the gengyin new moon of the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Coal Mountain.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on gengyin new moon, summer coolness at Coal Mountain.

units.zh: 丁巳，西平王李繼遷薨，其子德昭遣使來告。
units.en: On dingsi day Western Peace King Li Jiqian died; his son Dezhao sent envoys to announce the death.
units.literal: On dingsi day Western Peace King Li Jiqian died; his son Dezhao dispatched envoys to come report.

units.zh: 六月己卯，贈繼遷尚書令，遣西上閣門使丁振吊慰。
units.en: On jimao day of the sixth month Li Jiqian was posthumously made palace secretary, and Western Upper Gate envoy Ding Zhen was sent with condolences.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on jimao day, posthumously granted Jiqian Palace Secretary; dispatched Western Upper Gate envoy Ding Zhen to offer condolences.

units.zh: 辛巳，党項來貢。
units.en: On xinsi day the Tangut came with tribute.
units.literal: On xinsi day the Tangut came with tribute.

units.zh: 乙酉，阻卜鐵剌裏率諸部來降。
units.en: On yiyou day Zubu chief Tieluli submitted with his tribes.
units.literal: On yiyou day Zubu chief Tieluli led the various tribes to come and surrender.

units.zh: 是月，修可敦城。
units.en: That month Kedun city was repaired.
units.literal: That month, repaired Kedun city.

units.zh: 秋七月庚戌，阻卜、烏古來貢。
units.en: On gengxu day in the seventh autumn month the Zubu and Wugu came with tribute.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on gengxu day, Zubu, Wugu came with tribute.

units.zh: 甲寅，以奚王府監軍耶律室魯為南院大王。
units.en: On jiayin day Xi princely establishment military inspector Yelü Shilu was appointed southern chancellery great king.
units.literal: On jiayin day made Xi princely establishment military inspector Yelü Shilu Southern Chancellery Great King.

units.zh: 八月乙酉，阻卜鐵剌裏來朝。
units.en: On yiyou day of the eighth month Zubu chief Tieluli came to court.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on yiyou day, Zubu Tieluli came to court.

units.zh: 丙戌，朝皇太后。
units.en: On bingxu day the Emperor attended upon the Empress Dowager.
units.literal: On bingxu day audience with Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 九月己亥，夏國李德昭遣使來謝吊贈。
units.en: On jihai day of the ninth month Western Xia's Li Dezhao sent envoys thanking the court for condolences and posthumous honors.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on jihai day, Xia State Li Dezhao dispatched envoys to come thank for condolences and posthumous gifts.

units.zh: 癸丑，幸女河湯泉，改其名曰松林。
units.en: On guichou day the court visited Nühe Hot Springs and renamed them Songlin.
units.literal: On guichou day favored Nühe Hot Springs, changed its name to Songlin.

units.zh: 冬十月丁巳朔，駐蹕七渡河。
units.en: On the dingsi new moon of the tenth winter month the court encamped at Qiduh River.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, on dingsi new moon, imperial halt at Qiduh River.

units.zh: 戊辰，以楚國王隆祐為西南面招討使。
units.en: On wuchen day Prince of Chu Longyou was appointed Southwestern Pacification Commissioner.
units.literal: On wuchen day made Prince of Chu Longyou Southwestern Pacification Commissioner.

units.zh: 十一月壬辰，故於越耶律休哥之子道士奴、高九等謀叛，伏誅。
units.en: On renchen day of the eleventh month Daoshinu, son of the late yuyue Yelü Xiuge, and Gao Jiu and others plotted rebellion and were executed.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on renchen day, former Yuyue Yelü Xiuge's son Daoshinu, Gao Jiu and others plotted rebellion, executed.

units.zh: 丙申，通括南院部民。
units.en: On bingshen day a universal registration of Southern Chancellery tribal households was ordered.
units.literal: On bingshen day universally registered Southern Chancellery tribal people.

units.zh: 十二月癸未，罷三京諸道貢。
units.en: On guiwei day of the twelfth month tribute missions from the three capitals and all circuits were abolished.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on guiwei day, abolished tribute from the three capitals and various circuits.

units.zh: 二十二年春正月丁亥，如鴛鴦濼。
units.en: In the twenty-second year of Tonghe, on dinghai day of the first spring month the Emperor went to Yuanyang Marsh.
units.literal: In the twenty-second year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on dinghai day, went to Yuanyang Marsh.

units.zh: 二月乙卯朔，女直遣使來貢。
units.en: On the yimao new moon of the second month the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: In the second month, on yimao new moon, the Jurchen dispatched envoys to come with tribute.

units.zh: 丙寅，南院樞密使邢抱樸薨，輟朝三日。
units.en: On bingyin day southern privy commissioner Xing Baopu died, and court was suspended for three days.
units.literal: On bingyin day Southern Chancellery Privy Commissioner Xing Baopu died; court mourning halted three days.

units.zh: 三月己丑，罷番部賀千齡節及冬至、重五貢。
units.en: On jichou day of the third month tribal tribute missions for the Thousand Age Festival, the winter solstice, and the Double Fifth were abolished.
units.literal: In the third month, on jichou day, abolished tribal congratulations for Thousand Age Festival and Winter Solstice, Double Fifth tribute.

units.zh: 乙未，西夏李德昭遣使上繼遷遺物。
units.en: On yiwei day Western Xia's Li Dezhao sent envoys presenting Li Jiqian's bequeathed possessions.
units.literal: On yiwei day Western Xia Li Dezhao dispatched envoys to present Jiqian's legacy possessions.

units.zh: 夏四月丁卯，朝皇太后。
units.en: On dingmao day of the fourth summer month the Emperor attended upon the Empress Dowager.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, on dingmao day, audience with Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 五月，清暑炭山。
units.en: In the fifth month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.
units.literal: Fifth month, summered for coolness at Coal Mountain.

units.zh: 六月戊午，以可敦城為鎮州，軍曰建安。
units.en: On wuwu day of the sixth month Kedun City was made Zhen Prefecture and its garrison named Jian'an Army.
units.literal: Sixth month, on wuwu day Kedun City was made Zhen Prefecture and its army called Jian'an.

units.zh: 秋七月甲申，遣使封夏國李德昭為西平王。
units.en: On jiashen day of the seventh autumn month envoys were sent to invest Li Dezhao of Western Xia as King of Xiping.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiashen day envoys were dispatched to invest Li Dezhao of Western Xia as King of Xiping.

units.zh: 丁亥，兀惹、蒲奴裏、剖阿裏、越裏篤、奧裏米等部來貢。
units.en: On dinghai day the Wunai, Punuli, Po'ali, Yuelidu, Aolimi, and other tribes came with tribute.
units.literal: On dinghai day the Wunai, Punuli, Po'ali, Yuelidu, Aolimi, and other tribes came with tribute.

units.zh: 八月丙辰，党項來貢。
units.en: On bingchen day of the eighth month the Tangut came with tribute.
units.literal: Eighth month, on bingchen day the Tangut came with tribute.

units.zh: 庚申，阻卜酋鐵剌裏來朝。
units.en: On gengshen day Zubu chief Tielili came to court.
units.literal: On gengshen day Zubu chief Tielili came to court.

units.zh: 戊辰，鐵剌裏求婚，不許。
units.en: On wuchen day Tielili requested marriage, and the request was refused.
units.literal: On wuchen day Tielili requested marriage; it was not granted.

units.zh: 丙子，駐蹕犬牙山。
units.en: On bingzi day the court halted at Quanya Mountain.
units.literal: On bingzi day the court halted at Quanya Mountain.

units.zh: 九月己丑，以南伐諭高麗。
units.en: On jichou day of the ninth month Goryeo was notified of the southern campaign.
units.literal: Ninth month, on jichou day Goryeo was notified of the southern campaign.

units.zh: 丙午，幸南京。
units.en: On bingwu day the court visited Nanjing.
units.literal: On bingwu day the court visited Nanjing.

units.zh: 女直遣使獻所獲烏昭慶妻子。
units.en: The Jurchen sent envoys presenting the wife and children of the captured Wu Zhaoqing.
units.literal: The Jurchen sent envoys presenting the wife and children of Wu Zhaoqing, whom they had captured.

units.zh: 丁未，致祭於太宗皇帝廟。
units.en: On dingwei day sacrifice was performed at Emperor Taizong's temple.
units.literal: On dingwei day sacrifice was performed at Emperor Taizong's temple.

units.zh: 以北院大王磨魯古、太尉老君奴監北、南王府兵。
units.en: Northern Court Great King Malugu and Grand Commandant Laojunnu were put in charge of the Northern and Southern Princely House troops.
units.literal: Northern Court Great King Malugu and Grand Commandant Laojunnu were put in charge of the Northern and Southern Princely House troops.

units.zh: 庚戌，命楚國王隆祐留守京師。
units.en: On gengxu day King of Chu Longyou was ordered to remain at the capital.
units.literal: On gengxu day King of Chu Longyou was ordered to remain at the capital.

units.zh: 閏月己未，南伐。
units.en: On jiwei day of the intercalary month the southern campaign began.
units.literal: Intercalary month, on jiwei day the southern campaign began.

units.zh: 癸亥，次固安。
units.en: On guihai day the court halted at Gu'an.
units.literal: On guihai day the court halted at Gu'an.

units.zh: 以所獲諜者射鬼箭。
units.en: A captured spy was used in the ghost-arrow rite.
units.literal: A captured spy was used to shoot ghost arrows.

units.zh: 甲子，以青牛白馬祭天地。
units.en: On jiazi day black ox and white horse were sacrificed to heaven and earth.
units.literal: On jiazi day black ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.

units.zh: 丙寅，遼師與宋兵戰於唐興，大破之。
units.en: On bingyin day the Liao army fought Song forces at Tangxing and inflicted a great defeat.
units.literal: On bingyin day the Liao army fought Song forces at Tangxing and inflicted a great defeat.

units.zh: 丁卯，蕭撻凜與宋軍戰於遂城，敗之。
units.en: On dingmao day Xiao Talin fought the Song army at Suicheng and defeated it.
units.literal: On dingmao day Xiao Talin fought the Song army at Suicheng and defeated it.

units.zh: 庚午，軍於望都。
units.en: On gengwu day the army encamped at Wangdu.
units.literal: On gengwu day the army encamped at Wangdu.

units.zh: 冬十月乙酉，以黑白羊祭天地。
units.en: On yiyou day of the tenth winter month black and white sheep were sacrificed to heaven and earth.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on yiyou day black and white sheep were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.

units.zh: 丙戌，攻瀛州，不克。
units.en: On bingxu day Ying Prefecture was attacked but not taken.
units.literal: On bingxu day Ying Prefecture was attacked but not taken.

units.zh: 甲午，下祁州，賚降兵以酒脯。
units.en: On jiawu day Qizhou was taken, and surrendering troops were rewarded with wine and dried meat.
units.literal: On jiawu day Qizhou was taken, and surrendering troops were rewarded with wine and dried meat.

units.zh: 祭天地。
units.en: Sacrifice was performed to heaven and earth.
units.literal: Sacrifice was performed to heaven and earth.

units.zh: 己酉，西平王李德昭遣使謝封冊。
units.en: On jiyou day King of Xiping Li Dezhao sent envoys thanking the court for the investiture.
units.literal: On jiyou day King of Xiping Li Dezhao sent envoys thanking the court for the investiture.

units.zh: 十一月癸亥，馬軍都指揮使耶律課裏遇宋兵於洺州，擊退之。
units.en: On guihai day of the eleventh month cavalry commander Yelü Keli encountered Song forces at Ming Prefecture and repelled them.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on guihai day cavalry commander Yelü Keli encountered Song forces at Ming Prefecture and repelled them.

units.zh: 甲子，東京留守蕭排押獲宋魏府官吏田逢吉、郭守榮、常顯、劉綽等以獻。
units.en: On jiazi day Eastern Capital regent Xiao Paiya captured Song officials of Wei prefecture Tian Fengji, Guo Shourong, Chang Xian, Liu Chuo, and others and presented them.
units.literal: On jiazi day Eastern Capital regent Xiao Paiya captured Song officials of Wei prefecture Tian Fengji, Guo Shourong, Chang Xian, Liu Chuo, and others and presented them.

units.zh: 丁卯，南院大王善補奏宋遣人遺王繼忠弓矢，密請求和。
units.en: On dingmao day Southern Court Great King Shanbu reported that Song had sent bows and arrows to Wang Jizhong and secretly requested peace.
units.literal: On dingmao day Southern Court Great King Shanbu reported that Song had sent bows and arrows to Wang Jizhong and secretly requested peace.

units.zh: 詔繼忠與使會，許和。
units.en: An edict ordered Wang Jizhong to meet the envoy, and peace was granted.
units.literal: An edict ordered Wang Jizhong to meet the envoy, and peace was granted.

units.zh: 庚午，攻破德清軍。
units.en: On gengwu day Deqing Army was captured.
units.literal: On gengwu day Deqing Army was captured.

units.zh: 壬申，次澶淵。
units.en: On renshen day the court halted at Chanyuan.
units.literal: On renshen day the court halted at Chanyuan.

units.zh: 蕭撻凜中伏弩死。
units.en: Xiao Talin was struck by a hidden crossbow bolt and died.
units.literal: Xiao Talin was struck by a hidden crossbow bolt and died.

units.zh: 乙亥，攻破通利軍。
units.en: On yihai day Tongli Army was captured.
units.literal: On yihai day Tongli Army was captured.

units.zh: 丁丑，宋遣崇儀副使曹利用請和，即遣飛龍使韓杞持書報聘。
units.en: On dingchou day Song sent Vice Commissioner for Court Ceremonies Cao Liyong seeking peace, and the Flying Dragon Commissioner Han Qi was immediately sent with a letter in reply.
units.literal: On dingchou day Song sent Vice Commissioner for Court Ceremonies Cao Liyong seeking peace, and the Flying Dragon Commissioner Han Qi was immediately dispatched with a letter in reply.

units.zh: 十二月庚辰朔，日有食之，既。
units.en: On the gengchen new moon of the twelfth month there was a total solar eclipse.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on the gengchen new moon there was a total solar eclipse.

units.zh: 癸未，宋復遣曹利用來，以無還地之意，遣監門衛大將軍姚柬之持書往報。
units.en: On guiwei day Song again sent Cao Liyong, and because there was no intention to return territory, Supervisory Gate Guard General Yao Jianzhi was sent with a letter in reply.
units.literal: On guiwei day Song again sent Cao Liyong, and because there was no intention to return territory, Supervisory Gate Guard General Yao Jianzhi was dispatched with a letter in reply.

units.zh: 戊子，宋遣李繼昌請和，以太后為叔母，願歲輸銀十萬兩，絹二十萬匹。
units.en: On wuzi day Song sent Li Jichang seeking peace, addressing the Empress Dowager as aunt and offering yearly payment of one hundred thousand taels of silver and two hundred thousand bolts of silk.
units.literal: On wuzi day Song sent Li Jichang seeking peace, addressing the Empress Dowager as aunt and offering yearly payment of one hundred thousand taels of silver and two hundred thousand bolts of silk.

units.zh: 許之，即遣閤門使丁振持書報聘。
units.en: Peace was granted, and Gate Commissioner Ding Zhen was immediately sent with a letter in reply.
units.literal: Peace was granted, and Gate Commissioner Ding Zhen was immediately dispatched with a letter in reply.

units.zh: 己丑，詔諸軍解嚴。
units.en: On jichou day an edict ordered all armies to stand down.
units.literal: On jichou day an edict ordered all armies to stand down.

units.zh: 是月，班師。
units.en: That month the army withdrew.
units.literal: That month the army withdrew.

units.zh: 皇太后賜大丞相齊王韓德昌姓耶律，徙王晉。
units.en: The Empress Dowager granted Grand Chancellor King of Qi Han Dechang the surname Yelü and transferred him to King of Jin.
units.literal: The Empress Dowager granted Grand Chancellor King of Qi Han Dechang the surname Yelü and transferred him to King of Jin.

units.zh: 是年，放進士李可封等三人。
units.en: That year jinshi Li Kefeng and two others passed the examinations.
units.literal: That year jinshi Li Kefeng and two others were passed and granted degree.

units.zh: 二十三年春正月戊午，還次南京。
units.en: In the twenty-third year, on wuwu day of the first spring month, the court returned and halted at Nanjing.
units.literal: In the twenty-third year, spring, first month, on wuwu day the court returned and halted at Nanjing.

units.zh: 庚申，大饗將卒，爵賞有差。
units.en: On gengshen day a great feast was held for generals and soldiers, and ranks and rewards were granted in varying measure.
units.literal: On gengshen day a great feast was held for generals and soldiers, and ranks and rewards were granted in varying measure.

units.zh: 二月丙戌，復置榷場於振武軍。
units.en: On bingxu day of the second month the border market at Zhenwu Army was restored.
units.literal: Second month, on bingxu day the border market at Zhenwu Army was restored.

units.zh: 丁巳，夏國遣使告下宋青城。
units.en: On dingsi day Western Xia sent envoys reporting the capture of Song's Qingcheng.
units.literal: On dingsi day Western Xia sent envoys reporting the capture of Song's Qingcheng.

units.zh: 辛酉，朝皇太后。
units.en: On xinyou day the court had audience with the Empress Dowager.
units.literal: On xinyou day the court had audience with the Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 以惕隱化哥為南院大王，行軍都監老君奴為惕隱。
units.en: Tiyin Huage was appointed Southern Court Great King, and mobile army supervisor Laojunnu was appointed tiyin.
units.literal: Tiyin Huage was made Southern Court Great King, and mobile army supervisor Laojunnu was made tiyin.

units.zh: 乙丑，振党項部。
units.en: On yichou day the Tangut tribes were pacified.
units.literal: On yichou day the Tangut tribes were pacified.

units.zh: 丁卯，回鶻來貢。
units.en: On dingmao day the Uyghur came with tribute.
units.literal: On dingmao day the Uyghur came with tribute.

units.zh: 丁丑，改易州飛狐招安使為安撫使。
units.en: On dingchou day the Feihu recruitment-and-pacification commissioner of Yi Prefecture was changed to pacification commissioner.
units.literal: On dingchou day the Feihu recruitment-and-pacification commissioner of Yi Prefecture was changed to pacification commissioner.

units.zh: 夏四月丙戌，女直及阿薩蘭回鶻各遣使來貢。
units.en: On bingxu day of the fourth summer month the Jurchen and Arsalan Uyghur each sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingxu day the Jurchen and Arsalan Uyghur each sent envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 乙未，鐵驪來貢。
units.en: On yiwei day the Iron Li came with tribute.
units.literal: On yiwei day the Iron Li came with tribute.

units.zh: 己亥，党項來侵。
units.en: On jihai day the Tangut invaded.
units.literal: On jihai day the Tangut invaded.

units.zh: 五月戊申朔，宋遣孫僅等來賀皇太后生辰。
units.en: On the wushen new moon of the fifth month Song sent Sun Jin and others to congratulate the Empress Dowager's birthday.
units.literal: Fifth month, on the wushen new moon Song sent Sun Jin and others to congratulate the Empress Dowager's birthday.

units.zh: 乙卯，以金帛賜陣亡將士家。
units.en: On yimao day gold and silk were granted to the families of soldiers killed in battle.
units.literal: On yimao day gold and silk were granted to the families of soldiers killed in battle.

units.zh: 丙寅，高麗以與宋和，遣使來賀。
units.en: On bingyin day Goryeo, because of peace with Song, sent envoys to offer congratulations.
units.literal: On bingyin day Goryeo, because of peace with Song, sent envoys to offer congratulations.

units.zh: 六月壬辰，清暑炭山。
units.en: On renchen day of the sixth month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.
units.literal: Sixth month, on renchen day the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

units.zh: 甲午，阻卜酋鐵剌裏遣使賀與宋和。
units.en: On jiawu day Zubu chief Tielili sent envoys congratulating the peace with Song.
units.literal: On jiawu day Zubu chief Tielili sent envoys congratulating the peace with Song.

units.zh: 己亥，達旦國九部遣使來聘。
units.en: On jihai day the nine tribes of Dadan state sent envoys on a friendly visit.
units.literal: On jihai day the nine tribes of Dadan state sent envoys on a friendly visit.

units.zh: 秋七月癸丑，問安皇太后。
units.en: On guichou day of the seventh autumn month the court inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on guichou day the court inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.

units.zh: 戊午，党項來貢。
units.en: On wuwu day the Tangut came with tribute.
units.literal: On wuwu day the Tangut came with tribute.

units.zh: 辛酉，以青牛白馬祭天地。
units.en: On xinyou day black ox and white horse were sacrificed to heaven and earth.
units.literal: On xinyou day black ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.

units.zh: 壬戌，烏古來貢。
units.en: On renxu day the Ugu came with tribute.
units.literal: On renxu day the Ugu came with tribute.

units.zh: 丁卯，女直遣使來貢。
units.en: On dingmao day the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: On dingmao day the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 阿薩蘭回鶻遣使來請先留使者，皆遣之。
units.en: Arsalan Uyghur sent envoys requesting the release of previously detained envoys, and all were sent off.
units.literal: Arsalan Uyghur sent envoys requesting the release of previously detained envoys; all were sent off.

units.zh: 九月甲戌，遣太尉阿裏、太傅楊六賀宋主生辰。
units.en: On jiaxu day of the ninth month Grand Commandant Ali and Grand Tutor Yang Liu were sent to congratulate the Song emperor's birthday.
units.literal: Ninth month, on jiaxu day Grand Commandant Ali and Grand Tutor Yang Liu were dispatched to congratulate the Song emperor's birthday.

units.zh: 冬十月丙子朔，鼻骨德來貢。
units.en: On the bingzi new moon of the tenth winter month the Bigud came with tribute.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on the bingzi new moon the Bigud came with tribute.

units.zh: 戊子，朝皇太后。
units.en: On wuzi day the court had audience with the Empress Dowager.
units.literal: On wuzi day the court had audience with the Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 甲午，駐蹕七渡河。
units.en: On jiawu day the court halted at Qidu River.
units.literal: On jiawu day the court halted at Qidu River.

units.zh: 癸卯，宋歲幣始至，後為常。
units.en: On guimao day Song's yearly tribute first arrived; afterward it became regular.
units.literal: On guimao day Song's yearly tribute first arrived; afterward it became regular.

units.zh: 十一月戊申，上遣太保合住、頒給使韓橁，太后遣太師盆奴、政事舍人高正使宋賀正旦。
units.en: On wushen day of the eleventh month the Emperor sent Grand Preceptor Hezhu and distribution commissioner Han Song, and the Empress Dowager sent Grand Preceptor Pannu and Secretariat drafter Gao Zheng to Song to congratulate the New Year.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on wushen day the Emperor dispatched Grand Preceptor Hezhu and distribution commissioner Han Song, and the Empress Dowager dispatched Grand Preceptor Pannu and Secretariat drafter Gao Zheng to Song to congratulate the New Year.

units.zh: 辛亥，觀漁桑乾河。
units.en: On xinhai day the court watched fishing on the Sanggan River.
units.literal: On xinhai day the court watched fishing on the Sanggan River.

units.zh: 丁巳，詔大丞相耶律德昌出宮籍，屬於橫帳。
units.en: On dingsi day an edict ordered Grand Chancellor Yelü Dechang removed from the palace household registry and affiliated with the Horizontal Tents.
units.literal: On dingsi day an edict ordered Grand Chancellor Yelü Dechang removed from the palace household registry and affiliated with the Horizontal Tents.

units.zh: 十二月丙申，宋遣周漸等來賀千齡節。
units.en: On bingshen day of the twelfth month Song sent Zhou Jian and others to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on bingshen day Song sent Zhou Jian and others to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

units.zh: 丁酉，復遣張若谷等來賀正旦。
units.en: On dingyou day Song again sent Zhang Ruogu and others to congratulate the New Year.
units.literal: On dingyou day Song again sent Zhang Ruogu and others to congratulate the New Year.

units.zh: 二十四年春正月，如鴛鴦濼。
units.en: In the twenty-fourth year, in the first spring month, the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, spring, first month, the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.

units.zh: 夏五月壬寅朔，幸炭山清暑。
units.en: On the renyin new moon of the fifth summer month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.
units.literal: Summer, fifth month, on the renyin new moon the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

units.zh: 幽皇太妃胡輦於懷州，囚夫人夷懶於南京，餘黨皆生瘞之。
units.en: Imperial Consort Hu Nian was confined at Huaizhou, Lady Yilan was imprisoned at Nanjing, and all remaining conspirators were buried alive.
units.literal: Imperial Consort Hu Nian was confined at Huaizhou, Lady Yilan was imprisoned at Nanjing, and all remaining conspirators were buried alive.

units.zh: 秋七月辛丑朔，南幸。
units.en: On the xinchou new moon of the seventh autumn month the court made a southern tour.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the xinchou new moon the court made a southern tour.

units.zh: 八月丙戌，改南京宮宣教門為元和，外三門為南端，左掖門為萬春，右掖門為千秋。
units.en: On bingxu day of the eighth month Nanjing Palace's Xuanjiao Gate was renamed Yuanhe, the outer three gates Nanduan, the left side gate Wanchun, and the right side gate Qianqiu.
units.literal: Eighth month, on bingxu day Nanjing Palace's Xuanjiao Gate was renamed Yuanhe, the outer three gates Nanduan, the left side gate Wanchun, and the right side gate Qianqiu.

units.zh: 是月，沙州敦煌王曹壽遣使進大食國馬及美玉，以對衣、銀器等物賜之。
units.en: That month Shazhou Dunhuang King Cao Shou sent envoys presenting Arabian horses and fine jade, and paired robes, silver vessels, and other items were granted in return.
units.literal: That month Shazhou Dunhuang King Cao Shou sent envoys presenting Arabian horses and fine jade; paired robes, silver vessels, and other items were granted in return.

units.zh: 九月，幸南京。
units.en: In the ninth month the court visited Nanjing.
units.literal: Ninth month, the court visited Nanjing.

units.zh: 冬十月庚午朔，帝率群臣上皇太后尊號曰睿德神略應運啟化承天皇太后，群臣上皇帝尊號曰至德廣孝昭聖天輔皇帝。
units.en: On the gengwu new moon of the tenth winter month the Emperor led the officials in bestowing on the Empress Dowager the honorific Sage Virtue, Divine Strategy, Responsive Fortune, Initiating Transformation, and Sustaining Heaven Empress Dowager, and the officials bestowed on the Emperor the honorific Utmost Virtue, Broad Filiality, Illustrious Sagacity, Heaven-Assisted Emperor.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on the gengwu new moon the Emperor led the officials in bestowing on the Empress Dowager the honorific Sage Virtue, Divine Strategy, Responsive Fortune, Initiating Transformation, and Sustaining Heaven Empress Dowager, and the officials bestowed on the Emperor the honorific Utmost Virtue, Broad Filiality, Illustrious Sagacity, Heaven-Assisted Emperor.

units.zh: 大赦。
units.en: A general amnesty was proclaimed.
units.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

units.zh: 是年，放進士楊佶等二十三人及第。
units.en: That year jinshi Yang Ji and twenty-two others passed the examinations.
units.literal: That year jinshi Yang Ji and twenty-two others were passed and granted degree.

units.zh: 二十五年春正月，建中京。
units.en: In the twenty-fifth year, in the first spring month, the Central Capital was built.
units.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, spring, first month, the Central Capital was built.

units.zh: 二月，如鴛鴦濼。
units.en: In the second month the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.
units.literal: Second month, the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.

units.zh: 夏四月，清暑炭山。
units.en: In the fourth summer month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

units.zh: 六月，賜皇太妃胡輦死於幽所。
units.en: In the sixth month Imperial Consort Hu was granted death at her place of confinement.
units.literal: Sixth month, Imperial Consort Hu was granted death at her place of confinement.

units.zh: 秋七月壬申，西平王李德昭母薨，遣使吊祭。
units.en: On renshen day of the seventh autumn month the mother of King of Xiping Li Dezhao died, and envoys were sent to mourn and sacrifice.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renshen day the mother of King of Xiping Li Dezhao died, and envoys were dispatched to mourn and sacrifice.

units.zh: 甲戌，遣使起復。
units.en: On jiaxu day envoys were sent to recall him from mourning.
units.literal: On jiaxu day envoys were dispatched to recall him from mourning.

units.zh: 九月，西北路招討使蕭圖玉討阻卜，破之。
units.en: In the ninth month Northwestern Road pacification commissioner Xiao Tuyu attacked the Zubu and defeated them.
units.literal: Ninth month, Northwestern Road pacification commissioner Xiao Tuyu attacked the Zubu and defeated them.

units.zh: 冬十月丙申，駐蹕中京。
units.en: On bingshen day of the tenth winter month the court halted at the Central Capital.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on bingshen day the court halted at the Central Capital.

units.zh: 十二月乙酉，振饒州饑民。
units.en: On yiyou day of the twelfth month famine victims of Raozhou were relieved.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on yiyou day famine victims of Raozhou were relieved.

units.zh: 二十六年春二月，如長濼。
units.en: In the twenty-sixth year, in the second spring month, the court went to Chang Marsh.
units.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, spring, second month, the court went to Chang Marsh.

units.zh: 夏四月辛卯朔，祠木葉山。
units.en: On the xinmao new moon of the fourth summer month sacrifice was performed at Mount Muye.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, on the xinmao new moon sacrifice was performed at Mount Muye.

units.zh: 五月庚申朔，還上京。
units.en: On the gengshen new moon of the fifth month the court returned to the Upper Capital.
units.literal: Fifth month, on the gengshen new moon the court returned to the Upper Capital.

units.zh: 丙寅，高麗進龍須草席。
units.en: On bingyin day Goryeo presented dragon-whisker grass mats.
units.literal: On bingyin day Goryeo presented dragon-whisker grass mats.

units.zh: 己巳，遣使賀中京成。
units.en: On jisi day envoys were sent to congratulate the completion of the Central Capital.
units.literal: On jisi day dispatched envoys to congratulate completion of the Central Capital.

units.zh: 庚午，致祭祖、懷二陵。
units.en: On gengwu day the court offered sacrifice at the Zu and Huai mausoleums.
units.literal: On gengwu day performed sacrifice at the Zu and Huai mausoleums.

units.zh: 辛未，駐蹕懷州。
units.en: On xinwei day the court encamped at Huaizhou.
units.literal: On xinwei day imperial halt at Huaizhou.

units.zh: 秋七月，增太祖、太宗、讓國皇帝、世宗謚，仍謚皇太弟李胡曰欽順皇帝。
units.en: In the seventh autumn month the posthumous titles of Emperor Taizu, Emperor Taizong, the Emperor Who Yielded the Realm, and Emperor Shizong were augmented; Imperial Younger Brother Li Hu was also posthumously titled Emperor Qinshun.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, augmented posthumous titles of Taizu, Taizong, Emperor Who Yielded the Realm, and Shizong; also posthumously titled Imperial Younger Brother Li Hu Emperor Qinshun.

units.zh: 冬十月戊子朔，幸中京。
units.en: On the wuzi new moon of the tenth winter month the court visited the Central Capital.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuzi new moon, favorably visited the Central Capital.

units.zh: 十二月，蕭圖玉奏討甘州回鶻，降其王耶剌裏，撫慰而還。
units.en: In the twelfth month Xiao Tuyu reported a campaign against the Ganzhou Uighurs, subdued their king Yelali, reassured the people, and returned.
units.literal: Twelfth month, Xiao Tuyu memorialized campaigning against Ganzhou Uighurs, reduced their king Yelali, pacified and returned.

units.zh: 是年，放進士史克忠等一十三人。
units.en: That year Shi Kezhong and twelve others passed the examinations.
units.literal: That year, jinshi Shi Kezhong and twelve others were passed and granted degree.

units.zh: 二十七年春正月，鉤魚土河。
units.en: In the twenty-seventh year, in the first spring month, the court went ice fishing on the Tu River.
units.literal: Twenty-seventh year, spring, first month, hooked fish on the Tu River.

units.zh: 獵於瑞鹿原。
units.en: The court hunted at Ruilu Plain.
units.literal: Hunted at Ruilu Plain.

units.zh: 夏四月丙戌朔，駐蹕中京，營建宮室。
units.en: On the bingxu new moon of the fourth summer month the court encamped at the Central Capital and began building palace halls.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingxu new moon, imperial halt at the Central Capital, constructing palace halls.

units.zh: 庚戌，廢霸州處置司。
units.en: On gengxu day the Bazhou disposition office was abolished.
units.literal: On gengxu day abolished Bazhou disposition office.

units.zh: 秋七月甲寅朔，霖雨，潢、土、斡剌、陰涼四河皆溢，漂沒民舍。
units.en: On the jiayin new moon of the seventh autumn month heavy rains caused the Huang, Tu, Wala, and Yinliang rivers to overflow and wash away civilian dwellings.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiayin new moon, continuous rain; Huang, Tu, Wala, and Yinliang four rivers all overflowed, washing away commoners' dwellings.

units.zh: 八月甲申，北幸。
units.en: On jiashen day of the eighth month the court made a northern tour.
units.literal: Eighth month, on jiashen day, northern tour.

units.zh: 冬十一月壬子朔，行柴冊禮。
units.en: On the renzi new moon of the eleventh winter month the firewood-and-script rites were performed.
units.literal: Winter, eleventh month, on renzi new moon, performed firewood-and-script rite.

units.zh: 十二月乙酉，南幸。
units.en: On yiyou day of the twelfth month the court made a southern tour.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on yiyou day, southern tour.

units.zh: 皇太后不豫。
units.en: The Empress Dowager fell ill.
units.literal: The Empress Dowager was unwell.

units.zh: 戊子，肆赦。
units.en: On wuzi day a general amnesty was proclaimed.
units.literal: On wuzi day proclaimed general amnesty.

units.zh: 辛卯，皇太后崩於行宮。
units.en: On xinmao day the Empress Dowager died at the traveling palace.
units.literal: On xinmao day the Empress Dowager died at the traveling palace.

units.zh: 壬辰，遣使報哀於宋、夏、高麗。
units.en: On renchen day envoys were sent to announce the mourning to Song, Western Xia, and Goryeo.
units.literal: On renchen day dispatched envoys to report mourning to Song, Xia, and Goryeo.

units.zh: 戊申，如中京。
units.en: On wushen day the court went to the Central Capital.
units.literal: On wushen day went to the Central Capital.

units.zh: 己酉，詔免賀千齡節。
units.en: On jiyou day an edict canceled observance of the Thousand Age Festival.
units.literal: On jiyou day an edict canceled congratulations for the Thousand Age Festival.

units.zh: 是歲，御前引試劉二宜等三人。
units.en: That year Liu Eryi and two others were examined before the throne.
units.literal: That year, imperial preliminary examination of Liu Eryi and two others.
